release_rules.correction_policy: Create a new dataset version rather than editing an immutable release.

generation_notes.row_target_policy: Explicit per-table targets are base counts before imperfection injection.
generation_notes.manifest_timestamp_policy: manifest_generated_at is fixed per dataset version for reproducible manifests.
generation_notes.domain_boundary: Finance covers chart-of-accounts hierarchy, transactions, double-entry ledger lines, budgets, and synthetic FX conversion.
generation_notes.currency_policy: Finance supports configured source currencies and uses USD as the sole v1.0 reporting currency.
